name: Public service-resumption demand
hypothesis: Buy a breakout after verified resumption and measurable new independent purchases.
spec: Setup: Restoration of an ecosystem service may renew attention to a related token. Entry: Buy a breakout after verified resumption and measurable new independent purchases. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit if service interruption returns or the demand breakout fails. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs operational status feeds (transfers, routers, pools) with timestamps
